reason: I'd go for the free visit, sure, but $13 a kid adds up fast on our budget when the library and church hall are free. I'd have to be sold on it being worth paying for more than once.
objection: Thirteen dollars every time for one kid, plus coffee I don't need, when I can meet my moms group for free. And I'd still worry about bigger kids running wild near my baby, even with a Baby Nook.
would_change_my_mind: A confirmed $8 moms-group rate that my group actually uses, plus seeing the Baby Nook is truly separated from the big kids.
